# How to send PR (pull-request)

* Make sure you've read [the contribution guidelines](./CONTRIBUTING.md), all of it.
* Make sure you've read [the code of conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
* Answer this question honestly with **YES**: _I've read all of the contribution guidelines and code of conduct, and I comply of those rules fully_
* Answer this question honestly with **YES**: _This is my code, I haven't used AI generated code_ (**AI generated code is not allowed in this project**)
* Answer this question honestly with **YES**: _This is my code, not written by anybody or anything else_
* Answer this question honestly with **YES**: _I've an open github issue and discussed everything with the project owner already, getting a green flag to the PR_
